name: Type into a titled window
description: Launch Notepad, focus it, verify foreground, then set text via UI Automation or WM_SETTEXT. Does not SendKeys.
rationale: Workflow pack: type into Notepad after foreground verify (no SendKeys).

side_effects: Brings an existing window to the foreground
